program_solutions:
(rule!
  (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (in-list (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) (objects g 0)))])
    (let* ((rs (remove-duplicates (map first (obj-cells obj))))
           (cs (remove-duplicates (map second (obj-cells obj)))))
      (cond [(= (length rs) 1)
             (let ((r (first rs)))
               (paint-cells out (list (list r (apply min cs)) (list r (apply max cs))) 7))]
            [(= (length cs) 1)
             (let ((c (first cs)))
               (paint-cells out (list (list (apply min rs) c) (list (apply max rs) c)) 7))]
            [else out]))))
